heading: Beta (join) node
text:
### Beta (join) node [IRET.7.4]

A beta node joins a stream of tokens arriving on its **left** with a
stream of facts arriving on its **right**, and passes what matches to its
children. Its state divides three ways:

**Inputs.** A left parent — another beta node, or nothing at all, which
marks this as the first pattern and makes working memory the left source.
A right alpha node supplying candidate facts. A list of cross-pattern
join predicates. And a flag marking the node **negative**, which inverts
the test: a NOT node propagates when the join finds *nothing*.

**Memory.** Only the left side is remembered. Tokens accumulate in the
left memory; the right side is not stored here, because the alpha node
already holds those facts.

**Outputs.** Two child lists, kept separate: further beta nodes, and
terminal nodes. A node may feed both.

`ds_rete_beta_node_t` is declared in `runtime/src/libds/rete/beta.h`.

idris.name: Iret_7_4__tok_ok
idris.note: A well-formed token: its facts have the rule's pattern kinds in order and values in the domain.

idris.name: Iret_7_4__tuple_ok
idris.note: The same for a bare match tuple.

idris.name: iret_7_4__match_tuples_ok
idris.note: Guarded tuples are well-formed.

idris.name: iret_7_4__prop_with_ok
idris.note: Re-propagation produces well-formed tokens.

idris.name: iret_7_4__tuples_dom
idris.note: Every enumerated tuple's values come from the domain.

idris.name: iret_7_4__tuples_kinds
idris.note: Every enumerated tuple has the pattern kinds.

idris.name: iret_7_4__bound_kind
idris.note: The i-th bound fact has the i-th pattern kind.

idris.name: iret_7_4__extend
idris.note: The join's denotation, not its memories: prefix every partial tuple with every candidate fact, facts outermost. Left memory, right alpha and the child lists are not modelled.

idris.name: iret_7_4__match_tuples
idris.note: The tuples that pass the rule's guard (its where clauses and join predicates), as a denotation of the beta chain.

idris.name: iret_7_4__tuples
idris.note: All tuples of live facts matching the pattern kinds, in pattern order with each position enumerated in working-memory order -- the creation order for matches one assertion completes. The node structure is not modelled.

idris.name: Iret_7_4__beta
idris.note: A beta node: its right alpha, its join tests over the positive prefix and the candidate [IRET.7.5], the negative flag [IRET.7.9], its left memory, and -- NOT nodes only -- block counts by token identity [IRET.7.9.4]. The right memory is the alpha's, as the clause says; the child lists are the chain's shape.

idris.name: iret_7_4__with_lmem
idris.note: Replace a node's left memory and counts.

idris.name: iret_7_7__store
idris.note: Store arriving tokens in the left memory; a NOT node records their block counts.

idris.name: Rlow_4_2_1__from_front
idris.note: The clause's tuples of the positive kinds, from a front of prefixes.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__from_front_view
idris.note: Every guarded, unblocked tuple of the positive kinds is a token the chain passes.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__recompute_agrees
idris.note: The chain's recompute is the clause's tuple set, guarded and unblocked.

idris.name: Rlow_4_2_1__same_kinds
idris.note: Two beta chains compared for the right alpha and the NOT flag of each node, and not for the join tests.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__same_shape_kinds
idris.note: Beta chains of one shape have the same alphas and flags.

idris.name: rlow_5_1__bound_kinds
idris.note: A token's fact at position j came through the j-th positive node's right alpha, so it has that alpha's schema.

idris.name: rlow_5_1__pos_kinds_same_kinds
idris.note: The positive nodes' alphas, read in order, are the same for chains of one kind.

idris.name: Lgra_6_1__same_rule
idris.note: TWO RULES THAT ARE ONE, extensionally: the same positive kinds, a guard that decides alike on every tuple, blockers that read the same kinds and decide alike, the same actions. The lowering builds closures and there is no function extensionality, so this is the equality a run can tell.

idris.name: Rlow_4_2_1__same_shape
idris.note: Two chains of one shape: node by node the same alpha, join tests and flag; the memories and counts may differ. What the propagation paths never change, so a chain keeps lowering to one rule.

idris.name: iret_7_4__match_tuples_same
idris.note: Rules that are one match the same tuples.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__same_shape_refl
idris.note: A chain has its own shape.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__same_shape_trans
idris.note: Shapes compose.

idris.name: Ldet_5_5__lex_sorted
idris.note: Tokens in the order the joins build them: pattern by pattern, facts outermost.

idris.name: Ldet_5_5__pos_sorted
idris.note: The facts a join node reads from its alpha, in working-memory order.

idris.name: iret_7_4__extend_lex_sorted
idris.note: A join's extensions, facts outermost, come out in pattern order.

idris.name: iret_7_4__match_sub
idris.note: A match over one working memory whose facts are live in another is a match over that one: the guard reads the facts alone.

idris.name: iret_7_4__tuples_lex_sorted
idris.note: THE ENUMERATION IS LEXICOGRAPHIC: the tuples of the positive kinds, facts outermost in working-memory order, are sorted by their keys in pattern order.

idris.name: iret_7_4__tuples_sub
idris.note: A tuple of the kinds whose facts all lie in a working memory is a tuple over it.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__filter_pos_sorted
idris.note: A sublist of a distinct working memory, taken by a test, sits at increasing positions: the facts of a kind, in order.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__lex_sorted_cons
idris.note: One join step keeps the order: the left token's position decides first.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__lex_to_sorted
idris.note: ONE EVENT'S MATCHES, all completed at one position, are in the key's order when they are in pattern order: the latest positions tie, so the key falls through to the lexicographic comparison.

idris.name: iret_7_4__tuples_empty
idris.note: Over empty working memory a rule has the nil tuple, if it has no positive pattern, or nothing.

idris.name: iret_7_4__chain_live
idris.note: A chain's LIVE pairs: each node's left memory against its right memory. By the view theorem a function of working memory.

idris.name: Iret_7_4__same_set
idris.note: Two lists with the same members, the relation the view is stated in: memories are sets [IRET.6.5], order is the terminal's.

idris.name: Iret_7_7__consistent
idris.note: THE CONSISTENCY RELATION, per chain suffix relative to the front it receives and the alpha memories as they stand: each node's left memory is that front, distinct; a NOT node's counts are its blockers; the terminal holds exactly what the last node passes, distinct. Stated node by node so that each propagation path is proved one node at a time.

idris.name: iret_7_4__same_set_append
idris.note: Same set is a congruence for append.

idris.name: iret_7_4__same_set_concat
idris.note: Same set is a congruence for concat-map.

idris.name: iret_7_4__same_set_filter
idris.note: Same set is a congruence for filter.

idris.name: iret_7_4__same_set_of_eq
idris.note: Equal lists are the same set.

idris.name: iret_7_4__same_set_refl
idris.note: Same set is reflexive.

idris.name: iret_7_4__same_set_sym
idris.note: Same set is symmetric.

idris.name: iret_7_4__same_set_trans
idris.note: Same set is transitive.

idris.name: iret_7_4__match_of_live
idris.note: And if they pass the guard, a current match.

idris.name: iret_7_4__tuple_of_live
idris.note: Facts of the pattern kinds, all live, are an enumerated tuple.

idris.name: iret_7_4__tuples_live
idris.note: Every enumerated tuple is made of live facts.
